name: dotted-glow-background
title: Dotted Glow Background
blurb: Grid of dots that pulse and glow individually with organic timing.
description: Canvas-based dotted background with per-dot phase and speed for organic shimmering. Each dot pulses between dim and bright, with a glow halo when bright. Pauses rendering when off-screen via IntersectionObserver.
use_when: A sophisticated, animated background that supports theme-aware CSS variable styling and needs to pause itself…
avoid_when: Requires CSS variable setup; limited customization without passing specific color props. Falls back to…
a11y: Purely decorative canvas overlay; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Continuous pulsing animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
